source: the published PDF (98 pages, 478 footnotes), text extracted with pdftohtml and read note by note
scope: every footnote; the body holds no parenthesised citation
built: 2026-09-17, by Claude, without reference to Ibid's output
rules: an authority is a published source outside the proceeding (docs/ACCURACY.md); pins are written as cited; 'm'/'case'/'celex' are the document meant, 'written' is what the footnote says where the two differ; role 'incidental' marks a mention that is neither to be required nor to be counted against Ibid

amended.change: added incidental entries for Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 in footnotes 47 and 48
amended.reason: the incidental entries for Regulation 802/2004 in those footnotes already said '(Regulation 139/2004 likewise)', but only 802/2004 was encoded, so the first comparison credited the Merger Regulation named inside Implementing Regulation 2023/914's title as finding 'EUMR, Article 14' and 'EUMR, Articles 11-13'. The change makes Ibid's result worse, not better: those two EUMR citations now count as missed.
